{{Top}}
{{Citation}}
{{Quote|This will be a day long remembered.|[[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]]|<ref name="Episode 4">{{Film|IV}}</ref>}}
A '''day''' was a unit of [[Time/Legends|time]] on the [[Galactic Standard Calendar]]. One day was the amount of time it took for a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] to make one complete rotation on its polar axis. Twenty-four [[Galactic Standard Time/Legends|standardized]] hours was considered to be a '''standard day'''.<ref name="Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game, Second Edition, Revised and Expanded">''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game, Second Edition, Revised and Expanded]]''</ref>

The length of a day varied between planets. The length of day for most terrestrial planets not subjected to tidal locking was in the range of 18 to 36 standard [[Standard hour/Legends|hours]]. Tide-locked planets did not have days. Satellite planets - [[Moon/Legends|moons]] orbiting a [[Gas giant/Legends|gas giant]] - were almost always tide-locked to the gas giant they orbited. Satellites may have days several dozen hours long (as long as it takes the satellite to orbit the gas giant).<ref name="Planets of the Galaxy, Volume One">''[[Planets of the Galaxy, Volume One]]'', pages 9, 15 – 16</ref>

{{Noncanonstart|legends=1}}
During [[Roan Novachez]]'s time at the [[Jedi academy]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], the days of the [[Standard week/Legends|week]] were organized as [[Monoday]], [[Duoday]], [[Triday]], [[Quadday]], [[Pentaday]], [[Hexaday]] and [[Heptaday]].
{{Noncanonend}}

==Days of the week==
# [[Primeday/Legends|Primeday]]<ref name="Dining">{{Hyperspace|url=fans/hyperspace/source/dexdiner/index.html|text=Dining at Dex's|int=Dining at Dex's}}</ref>
# [[Centaxday/Legends|Centaxday]]<ref name="Dining" />
# [[Taungsday/Legends|Taungsday]]<ref name="Dining" />
# [[Zhellday/Legends|Zhellday]]<ref name="Dining" />
# [[Benduday/Legends|Benduday]]<ref name="Dining" />

Some locales had other names for days of the week, including [[Thursday/Legends|Thursday]]<ref name="The Last of the Jedi: Master of Deception">''[[The Last of the Jedi: Master of Deception]]''</ref> and [[Saturday/Legends|Saturday]].<ref name="SWG">{{GalaxiesNGE}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The length of the standard day is derived from the length of one [[Wikipedia:Earth|Earth]] day.

[[Star Wars (1977) 7|''Star Wars: New Planets, New Perils!'']] mentioned [[Sunday school]], but gave no indication it was named for a day of the week.<ref name="SW7">[[Star Wars (1977) 7|''Star Wars'' (1977) 7]]</ref>
